messages:
kevin: staging-bolt bring-up next Tue — need a quota lock in eu-north1 for 40 A100s (80GB) for ~2 weeks to seed the cluster. short timeline, can someone drive procurement? @maria?

maria: on it. i'll start the cloud quota flow and pull billing numbers. tagging @josh for network gating details.

josh: network checklist: /29 public, 2x interconnects (redundant), and peering to prod-vpc. also confirm we have the right BGP ASN. ops-bot, do we have a firewall template for eu-north1?

ops-bot: firewall template available: prod-edge-v2. recommended tags = [redwood-staging, cluster:staging-bolt]. docs: https://internal/templates/fw/prod-edge-v2 :thumbsup:

kevin: copying the quota payload i'm about to submit — pls sanity-check before i hit the portal:
```json
{
  "project": "redwood-staging-eun1",
  "region": "europe-north1",
  "request": {
    "gpu_type": "A100-80GB",
    "count": 40,
    "duration_days": 14,
    "reservation_label": "bringup-staging-bolt",
    "preemption_policy": "prefer_spot"
  },
  "justification": "Cluster bootstrap for staging-bolt; required for perf and failover testing. one-time temporary reservation."
}
```

maria: payload looks good. tiny tweak: set preemption_policy -> "partial" so control-plane nodes can be non-preemptible later. i'll add cost center and submit. also creating internal ticket and tagging finance.

josh: note — control-plane needs 4 non-preemptible GPUs reserved (separate line item). add that in the ticket so vendor doesn't hand back all preemptible instances.

rachel: i will own the operational handoff doc for oncall. checklist i'll publish in the runbook: 1) quota approved + reservation id, 2) infra bootstrap smoke tests, 3) nvlink check, 4) perf baseline (p99 latency), 5) traffic shift plan, 6) cost owner assigned.

kevin: @linda FYI re: cost. rough est is ~$72k for the two-week reservation incl. baseline egress. :pray:

linda: finance ok for one-off spend up to $80k pending ops sign-off. please attach the vendor invoice to the ticket when available.

maria: submitted cloud portal request -> ticket INC-3129. quoted ETA 48h if no vendor follow-ups. added notes about control-plane non-preemptible block. i'll post the reservation id when available.

kevin: if this stalls, fallback plan: deploy smaller pool in eu-west3 with 24 A100s and ramp autoscaler to burst on-demand. also enable kv-cache warmup to reduce token cost during perf tests.

deploy-bot: reservation 'staging-bolt-2245' created (status: pending). :package:

maria: updated INC-3129 with reservation 'staging-bolt-2245' and vendor contact info. monitoring for approval, will escalate to cloud rep if no reply in 24h.

kevin: great — thanks all. once approved rachel and josh will run the preflight checklist and i'll coordinate the DR plan. :thumbsup:
